shortDescription: RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate CBT II Exam City Intimation Slip and Admit Card 2026 for CEN 07/2025. CBT II is scheduled for 17 September 2026.
content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate CBT II exam city details for CEN 07/2025. Eligible candidates can download the exam city slip and CBT II e-call letter from the official RRB Digialm portal.

RRB NTPC UG CBT II schedule

  • CBT II exam city available: 07 September 2026
  • CBT II exam date: 17 September 2026
  • Admit card: generally available about 4 days before the exam
  • Total posts: 3,050

How to download

  1. Open the official login link below.
  2. Enter your registration number and date of birth or password.
  3. Download the exam city slip and admit card when activated.
  4. Check the exam date, shift, reporting time and centre address.
  5. Carry the printed e-call letter and original photo ID.

The exam city slip is for travel information and is not a substitute for the admit card.
